prompt: A lithe elf druid in deep emerald and moss-green leather robes, kneeling on a mossy forest floor with both hands plunged into the dark soil between gnarled tree roots. Two bright lime-green streams of glowing mana well up and spiral between her fingers, channeled from the earth. The background is a dense old-growth forest of towering trunks, the only light the green glow of the rising mana.

A tall elf druid in weathered bark-brown and deep-green robes, standing in side profile facing west, raising a gnarled wooden staff overhead. Two distinct emerald orbs of glowing mana orbit the staffs head, doubled and bright. The background is a misty pine forest at dusk, the only light the twin green orbs casting glow on the ferns below.

Close three-quarter portrait of a young elf druid with pointed ears and braided auburn hair, wearing forest-green homespun, cupping both hands together at chest height. Two intertwined wisps of bright lime and deep emerald mana rise from her cupped palms, lighting her face from below. The background is a sunlit green forest clearing, leaves and dappled light behind her.

A wide forest scene at twilight: a robed elf druid stands centered with both palms raised, acting as a conduit. Glowing sap-green light surges up through the gnarled tree roots and the mossy ground around her feet and streams up into her open hands. The background is a cathedral of enormous ancient trunks, the only light the green energy crawling up the roots.

An elf druid with antler-adorned headdress and deep-green cloak, crouched low beside a glowing mossy boulder, pressing one hand to the stone. Two ribbons of bright green mana flow from the boulder up her arm. The background is a dense fern-choked forest understory, the only light the green mana ribbons and faint shafts of canopy light.

A barefoot elf druid in layered moss-green and fern robes, seated cross-legged on the forest floor, both hands resting palm-up on her knees. From each open palm a separate column of bright lime-green mana rises, two distinct glowing streams. The background is a deep old-growth forest, the only light the two green mana columns illuminating her serene face.

An elderly elf druid with a long white beard and deep-green hooded cloak, side profile facing east, kneeling and pressing both palms flat against the trunk of a massive ancient oak. Bright emerald sap-light flows out of the bark into his hands in two glowing veins. The background is a shadowed forest grove, the only light the green sap-glow on the bark.

A lithe elf druid in deep emerald leather, kneeling on a mossy forest floor with both hands plunged into glowing soil. A bright twisting column of lime-green mana surges up from between her hands. The background is a dense old-growth forest of towering dark trunks, the only light the green mana column casting a glow across the moss.

A young elf druid woman with braided hair and a green tunic, standing three-quarter view, both arms outstretched low with palms open. Two separate spirals of glowing green mana coil upward from the mossy ground into each palm. The background is a fern-filled forest clearing at golden hour, warm light through the canopy behind the green glow.

Low worms-eye view of an elf druid in moss-green robes seen from below, hands raised together overhead, drawing two bright lime-green torrents of mana up from the earth around her. Towering forest trunks frame her on both sides converging upward. The only light is the twin green mana torrents glowing against the dark canopy.
